title: Conformal Symmetry and Non-Singular Scalar field Collapse
summary: We investigate the gravitational collapse of a massive scalar field in a conformally flat, spherically symmetric spacetime within general relativity. The collapsing matter distribution is modeled using a minimally coupled homogeneous scalar field together with both perfect fluid and dissipative matter sectors. Imposing conformal flatness through the vanishing of the Weyl tensor considerably constrains the geometry and enables the construction of exact analytical solutions.
